$comment: Canonical inventory of screenshot-worthy app states — see docs/RELEASE_SCREENSHOTS_PLAN.md Phase 1. Consumed by StarHubTHUITests/Sources/ScreenshotCapture/ScreenshotCaptureTool.swift (Phase 3.1) and scripts/check_screenshot_coverage.py (Phase 3.2, diffs sidebar-tab-* identifiers found in source against 'navigation' entries here, to catch new features that never got added). Tokens like <folderName> in an 'identifier' are resolved at capture time from a local, gitignored targets file — see scripts/screenshot_targets.example.json.

screens.description: Home dashboard — avatar header, app info, game folder, SMAPI status

screens.precondition: At least one out-of-date mod or SMAPI error must exist — this row is only visible when alertCount > 0.

screens.description: Save Editor — avatar, notes, character info, inventory
screens.precondition: targets.saveFolderName must name a real save in the maintainer's gameDir, visible without scrolling — Saves search matches playerName/farmName, not the on-disk folder, so it can't help locate an arbitrary save and isn't attempted.

navigation.note: savesStore.saveViewMode is a store-level @Published property, not per-view @State — it leaks across entries. A prior saves-grid entry running before this one left the view in grid mode, where SaveCardView (not SaveRow) renders — save-row-menu-<folder> only exists in list mode. Confirmed via a debug screenshot at the failure point showing the grid, not the list.
index 0 is 'Save Management' — see SaveRow.swift's Menu item order

screens.precondition: targets.saveFolderName must name a real save with at least one backup, visible without scrolling.

navigation.note: index 1 is 'Timeline' — see SaveRow.swift's Menu item order
list.bullet is segment 0, square.grid.2x2 is segment 1 — see ModControlsBar.swift's Picker

screens.description: Mods — group row expanded (multi-file mod, missing-dependency warning)
screens.precondition: targets.groupFolderName must name a real multi-file/group mod with a missing dependency.

navigation.note: modListViewMode is an @AppStorage value — it persists across the whole app session, not just this entry, so a prior mods-grid entry leaves it in grid mode where mod-row-<folder> doesn't exist at all (ModCardView, not ModListRow). Force list mode back explicitly rather than assume.
clicking the group row itself toggles expansion

screens.precondition: targets.modFolderName's manifest UpdateKeys must resolve to a real Nexus mod for real cover/description data; targets.modSearchQuery must be a substring of that mod's real name/uniqueId/author.

navigation.note: modListViewMode is an @AppStorage value — persists across the whole session, so a prior mods-grid entry can leave this on grid mode.
Mods search matches name/uniqueId/author (ModListFilter.swift), not the on-disk folder — filtering to one match avoids relying on scroll-into-view against a 100+-mod real library.

mod-row-info-button-<folder>'s own identifier is silently clobbered by the row's mod-row-<folder> identifier — same issue as the config-gear button (SWIFT_STANDARDS.md §10). Located via an explicit .accessibilityLabel("mod-info-button") on the button itself, not the SF Symbol name (info.circle's default auto-generated accessibility label turned out not to be the literal string "info.circle" — confirmed by a debug screenshot showing the button clearly present and clickable while this lookup still failed).

screens.description: Mod Config Editor — Visual tab (grouped settings tree)
screens.precondition: targets.configModFolderName must have a config.json — deliberately a separate token from modFolderName: the mod chosen to demonstrate real Nexus description data often isn't the same real mod that happens to ship a config.json.

navigation.note: modListViewMode is an @AppStorage value — persists across the whole session, so a prior mods-grid entry can leave this on grid mode.

ModListRow's config-gear button has no identifier of its own — SWIFT_STANDARDS.md §10 documents why (row identifier clobbers descendant identifiers); same lookup ModConfigEditRoundTripUITests already uses.

screens.precondition: At least one mod profile must exist.

screens.description: ModPacks — empty drop-zone / URL import prompt
ModPacks — imported collection banner + per-mod rows
screens.precondition: A real Nexus Collection must already be imported — data precondition, not a navigation gap.
Only visible when @AppStorage("showDeveloperLogs") is true — enable it in Settings first.
